desc: Read input N, M and edges.
Build adjacency list for the graph.
Use BFS/DFS to find connected components and determine bipartition sizes $(a_i, b_i)$ for each component.
Collect the differences $D_i = a_i - b_i$ for all components.
Use a bitset DP to find the subset sum of $D_i$'s (with signs) that is closest to 0. Specifically, find the minimum absolute value of $\sum s_i D_i$.
Calculate the optimal $|A|$ and $|B|$, then compute total edges $K = |A| \cdot |B|$.
If moves is odd, print "Aoki", else print "Takahashi".
